annotations.title: Where can I serve (publicly listed needs)

description: List up to 20 open volunteer needs (needs that ask for people's time, in person or remotely; funding-only needs excluded) posted publicly by verified ministries and Christian nonprofits on the Serve network, filtered by city and country name and optionally remote-only, through the public Kingdom Protocol read: what is needed, urgency, city and country, in person or remote, the ministry and its page, and a machine-readable data URL. Use for "where can I volunteer" or "something I can help with remotely". For needs near coordinates with distance, or needs that can be funded, use needs_near. city and country are text filters combined with AND; omit both for the whole network. Never coordinates or contacts. No match returns count 0. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

country.description: Optional country filter, name or ISO code: "Rwanda", "US".

remote_only.description: true: only needs that can be met remotely.

name: where_can_i_serve_publicly

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

honest.description: Present when count is 0: what the empty result means.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

needs.description: Each need: id, title, category, urgency, city, region, country, local (in person possible), remote (remote possible), ministry name and page, and its public JSON data URL.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Where can I serve (publicly listed needs)
